text:
sec-oncall: P1 advisory: private SSH key for `deploy@redwood-ci` was found in an unredacted artifact stored in S3 (artifact key: builds/2026/03/22/infra-deploy.tar.gz). This key can be used to push to our git repos and access deploy hosts. Immediate containment required.
ci-bot: DLP alert: possible private-key PEM block detected in artifact builds/2026/03/22/infra-deploy.tar.gz (sha256: a3f2...). Rule matched: PEM_PRIVATE_KEY.
build-sre: ack. I'm isolating the artifact bucket and disabling public access. Running `aws s3api put-bucket-policy --bucket redwood-builds --policy file://deny-public.json` and `s3ctl quarantine builds/2026/03/22/infra-deploy.tar.gz` now.
alice: which repos had that key configured as a deploy key? I can list repo deploy keys and revoke.
build-sre: scanning Repos API for key fingerprint now: `gh api -X GET /repos --jq ".[] | .full_name" | xargs -n1 -I{} gh api repos/{}/keys` then filter by fingerprint `ab:cd:ef:12:34`.
bob: starting rotation: will remove `deploy@redwood-ci` key from all repos and revoke any matching SSH sessions on bastion hosts. ETA 20m.
devops: disabling CI job `infra-deploy` across org until rotation completes: setting pipeline to paused.
sec-oncall: required actions for repo owners: 1) Revoke any deploy keys matching fingerprint ab:cd:ef:12:34 2) Rotate machine credentials and replace with new keys stored in Vault 3) Invalidate any short-lived sessions created by that key (bastion, git pushes) 4) Audit commit history for unauthorized commits between 2026-03-22T02:00Z and 2026-03-22T04:00Z.
alice: revoke command for GitHub (org owners): `gh api -X DELETE /repos/:owner/:repo/keys/:key_id` after listing keys. I'll push a script to automate for all repos.
ci-bot: automated action: scanned 142 repos, matched 5 repos with the fingerprint: infra/terraform, infra/packer, infra/ansible, website, infra/ci-scripts.
bob: removed key from those 5 repos. Also removed the key from `~deploy/.ssh/authorized_keys` on bastion pool member b-03 and b-04.
eng-manager: any signs of code pushes or suspicious deploys using the key?
build-sre: audit logs: found two git push events from the key at 02:18 UTC to repo infra/ci-scripts branch hotfix/cleanup. We are reverting the push and validating commits.
alice: reverting push: `git revert <sha>` and opening PR with revert. Also running `git fsck` and audit for other tampered refs.
sec-oncall: forensics: capture the artifact, object metadata, access logs, and the CI job logs that produced the artifact. We're treating this as potential compromise until proven otherwise.
devops: creating short-lived emergency deploy tokens for critical paths while we rotate machine keys. Keys will be JWT-based with 1h expiry and stored in Vault with rotation tag.
legal: please collect list of repos impacted and any downstream customers/services that might pull those artifacts. We may need to notify partners if signed releases were affected.
bob: replaced machine key for deploy@redwood-ci with a new key pair; private key stored at `secret/ssh/deploy-ci-20260322` and marked rotated-by=bob.
sec-oncall: checklist for owners: A) Revoke deploy key(s) and confirm deletion from repo settings B) Rotate any machine credentials and update Vault references C) Rebuild artifacts that included the key and republish D) Run `git log --since="2026-03-22T02:00" --all --grep="deploy@redwood-ci"` to surface related commits E) Update CI to avoid packaging private keys into artifacts: add `!**/*.pem` to packaging globs and add DLP gate to artifact uploads.
alice: opened infra PR to add a packaging lint and DLP pre-upload hook: infra/ci-scripts#101. Will add test that artifacts do not contain PEM blocks.
ci-bot: artifact uploads now blocked if DLP rule PEM_PRIVATE_KEY matches. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/artifact-secrets
eng-manager: please prepare an exec summary after containment: include scope, impact, and remediation timeline.
sec-oncall: containment status: artifact quarantined, key revoked from repos and bastions, new keys issued and stored in Vault, CI paused for affected job, DLP gate added. ETA verify and close: 3h. Postmortem to follow.
